subject: How many IICs exist in India
why_it_matters: A 16% spread across three government sources on the most important count in this market. None states the counting rule - registered, active, or ever-submitted - so they are not reconcilable. We therefore refuse to pick one and state a range instead.
our_choice: Use 14,067 as the CONSERVATIVE floor and 16,367 as the CEILING. Report both. Never present a single IIC count.

subject: What counts as an institution that could buy innovation software
why_it_matters: These three numbers answer three different questions and are NOT nested. An IIC can sit inside a college; a college can file NIRF Overall without filing Innovation. Adding them produces a number that describes nothing.
our_choice: Never sum these. Model each as a separate population and reconcile them by institution type in data_p47.

subject: DPIIT recognised startup count moves fast
why_it_matters: 17,009 additional recognitions in roughly four months. Any denominator built on a startup count decays within a year, so market sizing must state its as-of date or be meaningless.
our_choice: Every sizing output carries an explicit as_of date.
